storage.note: deposit = bytes × env::storage_byte_cost() read at run time; depositSandbox at the sandbox protocol config (10000000000000000000 yocto per byte)

account.layout: NEP-145 registration of a 64-char account id: key b"f" ‖ Borsh(AccountId) 69 B, value u128 16 B, record overhead 40 B (token ACCOUNT_STORAGE_BYTES; the fixed min == max of every holder)

uaBalance.layout: UA ledger record: key b"u" ‖ id 33 B, value u128 16 B, record overhead 40 B (token UA_STORAGE_BYTES)

subjectEd25519Ua.layout: subject account of a UA with one ed25519 key, no origin / guardian / recovery: key b"a" ‖ Borsh(Holder::Ua) 34 B, value Borsh(Subject) 56 B (keys 4 + 38, origins 4, guardian 1, recovery 1, key_nonce 8), record overhead 40 B; any subject record = 41 + Borsh(holder) + Borsh(subject) (token SUBJECT_RECORD_OVERHEAD, measured in `new`); a second ed25519 key +38 B (168 B, test ua_opened_lazily_relayer_pays_storage)
